strings.en: I don't intend to drag this out...!
Now that you've come out in front of me...!
Leave the vanguard to the Boxer!
I'll draw out Type Haken's full performance!
Scum who toy with life and death...!
Drowning in rage, you'll never get a chance to win!
That obsession... I'll shake it off right here!
Al-Van's Raftclans./　I can't afford to let my guard down!
A knight of the Fury... I can't be careless.
The black Raftclans... No more of this!
Karo-Ran... I won't let things go your way!
Someone who holds up a twisted cause like you/　thinks he can take the emperor's seat?!
If you mean to get in our way, be prepared...!
If only to learn what they're after...!
That Raig-Geios's movements... I can't be careless.
So you're the mastermind behind Golaikunru...!
Vort, I won't let you do as you please!
Know that excessive ambition leads to ruin, Herluga!
Herluga... I won't hand the Cross Gate to you!
Eliminating the Gadisword unit in our path!
Your laughter grates on my ears...!
If it's unmanned, I'll destroy it.
Whatever you control, the outcome won't change.
Skull Knight, get out of my sight!
So he's another Dark Brain remnant!
Leading the Lamaris around... What are you plotting...!
I will never accept your existence, XN-L!
XN-L, I won't let you go to any world!
I'll end this fight with your annihilation!
We can't leave the Zovorg units alone!
I won't let Golaikunru do as they please!
Golaikunru, stop meddling in the Earth Sphere!
Long range or not, if I get inside your guard...!
I can't let you through here.
However high its performance,/　as long as I know how to deal with it...!
If I take down the Commander's unit...!
No matter how thick the barrage...!
If it's an alien new model, I can't be careless.
I'll take down that Thick Cylinder!
Leave that White Horn to me!
The Raftclans... It has to be defeated!
Leave the mass-produced Gyanonia to me!
With the enemy base right in front of us,/　we have no choice but to retreat...!
This has to be some bad joke.
Keep the jokes to your appearance.
A monster... There's no other word for it.
We can't spend time on the Lamaris.
An absurd existence, but I have to accept it.
Even if it's a Kaana type!
Lamaris Ida... We can't leave that thing alone.
Even if its form has changed, if it's Ares Geist...!
First, I'll stop Ares Geist's movements...!
I won't let you become Dark Brain's vessel!
I guess I have to accept it as normal.
I can't keep calling things absurd now.
I'm used to monsters like that by now.
Offense and defense are one. My turn!
That won't be enough to stop me.
Too bad. I can still move.
Attacking me was your bad luck.
Giving me a chance to counter was your mistake!
I'm not soft enough to let you withdraw.
Tch, I'll have to bail out...!
Damage past 70%...!/　But I can still fight!
Keep cool...!/　Spirit alone won't get me through this...!
Rush now, and I'll only destroy myself...!
I haven't lost sight of the key/　to getting through this...!
Even this armor couldn't stop it...!
Guh!/　It pierced the Razangriff's armor!
Hold on, Exbein, don't go down yet...!
Using the Cross Gate like that/　can't end without a price...!
We can't let him sit on the throne...!
I have to hold back XN-L, no matter what...!
Guh! We need to hurry and wipe out the Ida type!
This little damage won't break/　my ability to Concentrate.
I left an opening.../　But that hit woke me up.
Heh, thick armor is its strong point.
Al-Van... My feints don't faze him at all.
It's too early to call yourself emperor...!
So his Gyanonia is in a class of its own...!
Are you saying you're the Cross Gate's gatekeeper...!
Am I cursed when it comes to women...?!
We don't need any meddling from you!
I have no intention of watching your show to the end.
Nothing but bones, so it's light on its feet...!
In the end, you're no different from Dark Brain!
So the enemy's analyzing our data too...
I'm too old to flinch at a few thorns...!
Looks like it's not just for show...!
I can't let the unknown's movements throw me off...!
I can't believe a Lamaris is keeping up with me...!
To be pushed this far by a Yokijin...!
Landing a hit is commendable... but...!
Not bad. You kept up with my moves.
Don't get cocky. That was just a lucky shot!
Heh... I still have a ways to go.
Sorry, it's as tough as it looks.
I'll give you credit for catching up to the Gunner.
Is that all, Jua-Mu? Just a hit?
And you call that an Emperor Unit?
Reggiane,/　can you really afford to hold back?
Looks like that power is too much for you,/　Herluga...!
I didn't expect Debudedabide to catch me off guard.
I misread the Zovorg unit's pattern...!
As expected, a Thorn can't be taken lightly.
Kh, I let its appearance fool me.
Hmph, that one moves in tricky ways.
The Kaana type... Even Combined, this is all it's got?
Getting caught by a Yokijin, huh.
In the Gunner, I can shake you off!
So-Des, don't think your petty tricks will work!
Your tricks won't work on me, Iradoya!
You're just a puppet, after all.
No matter how many absurd tricks you use...!
You're the one who'll be destroyed, XN-L!
You seem different from before, but I can read you!
I won't fall behind a Zovorg unit!
Your patterns are as predictable as ever.
Come this way, just like that.
Thorn or not, I can read its movements!
That motion was far too obvious.
Sorry, but that won't work on me!
The moment you made your move,/　this outcome was decided.
Keep your mind calm,/　and it's child's play.
Its mobility's improved since last time.
I don't fly just for show.
The Boxer's mobility is more than it looks.
The Leonysis's reaction speed is quite something.
Is that all Herluga's right-hand man amounts to?
I can't count on it running out of energy...
For all its size, its aim is sloppy.
So the Ida type is all show.
Hmph. All show and no substance.
Sorry, but I came prepared for this.
That's the Jammer's power. Nice try.
So this is what comes/　of losing your composure...
Looks like you failed to dodge.
Carla, leave the rest to me!
Well done, Carla. That kept them pinned.
Bullet, leave the rest to me!
Fall back, Tasuku. The rest is my job!
Leaving me to clean up the mess...
Major, I'll take it from here!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Touma, leave the rest to me!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll back you up!
Moving in to back up Akimi!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I've still got room to spare!
Leona, I'll take care of this one!
You'd better be ready for a lecture, Arado!
Still haven't broken that Assault habit, Arado.
Major, leave this one to me!
Good position... I can do this!
At this range... a direct hit!
Twin Solid Cannons.../　I'll blast right through you!
At this range... the Solid Cannons can do it!
I'll take you all out at once!
At this range, a direct hit!
Can you keep up with this speed?!
Rapid fire! You won't get away!
I'll push through with the Jigan's power!
A flurry of blows! Take this!!
Behold the power of the super warrior.
There's no escaping the star of ill omen...!
Taste the super warrior's secret art!
Begone, to the far reaches of ill fortune...!
With Raptor and Bison working together!
The Shishioh name is no empty boast.
These are Tesla Drive Missiles--/　you can't escape!
Light from the heavens! There's no escape!
Close combat is where this thing really shines!
This is where it really begins!
This destructive power... It's worth the risk.
Can you dodge this many Missiles?!
Sink into the vortex of gravity!!
Savor the Knight Foul combination/　to your heart's content!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Taste the Type-2's secret technique firsthand!
Vanish with the twinkle of the evil star...!
I'll show you the Pfeil III's combination.
Don't think you can escape the Cylion!
High-speed combat is where/　the Cylion's true worth shows!
I'll hit you as many times as I can!
You can't keep up with these moves!
This will stop you in your tracks!
